This file is intended to plot the Mean Square Error generated during a experiment (frame by frame).

To correctly see the plot, first set the working directory (change the next path to the one you want).

```{r}
setwd("../results")
```

Next, introduce the name of the file containing the MSE of your experiment.

```{r}
filename = "motion_results_24.Apr.2015_11:39:47.csv"
```


That's all you need to you. If everything went ok, next chunk should show you the plot.

```{r}
data = read.csv(filename, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
x= 1:nrow(data)
y = as.numeric(data$Mean.Square.Error)
plot(x, y, type = "l", col = "red", lwd=3, ylim = c(0,1), xlab = "Frame", 
     ylab = "Normalized Error", main = "Normalized Mean Square Error")
```
